title: ¿Conquista o catástrofe?
goal: Read why most conquest accounts were written by the winning side, meet the 20th-century work that gathered rare indigenous testimony, and learn why battle deaths were a fraction of the real toll.

items: Explain why written sources on the conquest are so one-sided.
Describe what 'Visión de los vencidos' is and who compiled it.
Explain what today's historians think of the 'white legend' and 'black legend'.
Explain why some historians distinguish 'conquest' from 'catastrophe'.
Use passive voice to describe how historical sources and interpretations were produced.
